# Global Examination of Mental State

::: {.lead}
Three **Open**, validated tools for the brief assessment of cognition: in person, by telephone, or self-administered on the web.
Each comes with normative data, cut-offs that account for cognitive reserve, and all the materials needed to use it, openly shared.
:::
:::

[In person · paper and pencil]{.module-mode}

::: {.module-title}
[GEMS](tests/gems/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.module-desc}
A paper-and-pencil screening of global cognition with 11 tasks covering orientation, memory, attention, visuo-spatial skills, language and pragmatics. It takes about 10 minutes.
:::

### Open materials, Open norms, Open code

Every GEMS tool is shared openly on this site, under the Creative Commons Attribution – NonCommercial 4.0 licence.
This covers record forms, instructions, normative data, scoring sheets, analysis code and apps.
You can use, translate and adapt them for non-commercial purposes, as long as you credit the original work.

### Open

Record forms, instructions, scoring sheets and code are shared openly on this site under the CC BY-NC 4.0 licence.
:::

::: {.strip-item}
<i class="bi bi-people"></i>

### Large normative samples

The norms are based on 600 to 1,300 healthy adults per test, covering the adult lifespan.
:::

::: {.strip-item}
<i class="bi bi-diagram-3"></i>

### Cognitive reserve

The cut-offs account for age, sex, education and the Cognitive Reserve Index (CRIq).
:::

::: {.strip-item}
<i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat"></i>

### Built for follow-up

Parallel forms A and B and significant-change thresholds support repeated assessments.
:::
:::
